services.desc: We apologise but there was a problem sending your message. Please contact customer support. Round out the school day with After School Clubs, Extended Day for little ones who need after hours care, and The Middle School After Hours program with homework support. After School Clubs are offered for students in Alpha through fourth grade with a variety of enrichment classes each session. Clubs meet weekly for an hour after school from 3-4pm. There are three club sessions offered throughout the school year: fall, winter and spring. Each session runs for approximately 8-10 weeks, depending on the day of the week. Does your child have a special interest you would like to see offered after school?
